reasoning: 驗證目標：選取 Sports 時，提供各聯盟的清單並可選取 My Game Zone。為什麼這樣切：條款有兩個並列產出——聯盟清單與 My Game Zone 的可選取性；後者是進入 100 的入口，故此處只驗其可被選取，不驗其內容（那是 100 的判準，§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Sports offers the league list and My Game Zone
tcs.test_item: If Sports is selected the HU shall provide a list of each of the leagues along with the ability to select the My Game Zone feature
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Sports content is available on the subscription
5. The Browse feature is open
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select Sports
2. Read the displayed list
3. Select My Game Zone
tcs.expected_result:
1. Sports is accepted as a selection
2. A list of leagues is displayed and My Game Zone is offered
3. My Game Zone is accepted as a selection
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
